About the job
Scheldewerf Foods produces chilled dairy desserts, plant-based drinks and private-label sauces for retailers in the Benelux, Germany and France. With five plants in Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany, 2,100 employees and EUR 780 million in revenue, we are one of the larger independent food manufacturers in the region.

To accelerate our indirect procurement programme, we are looking for a freelance Category Manager Indirect for an initial period of nine months.

What you will do
- Develop and implement category strategies for facility management, maintenance, repair and operations (MRO), logistics services and marketing services, with a total addressable spend of approx. EUR 70 million
- Run sourcing events end-to-end in SAP Ariba, from RFI to award, including should-cost models and TCO comparisons
- Negotiate framework agreements with index-based price clauses and service level agreements
- Consolidate the supplier base across our five plants and set up performance reviews with the top 40 suppliers
- Track and report savings together with Finance, in line with our savings validation policy
- Work closely with plant managers, the logistics team and marketing as internal stakeholders

What we are looking for
- At least 8 years of experience in strategic procurement, including category management for indirect spend
- Hands-on experience with SAP Ariba Sourcing and Contracts
- Proven negotiation skills and a structured, data-driven approach (spend analysis, Excel, Power BI)
- Experience in food, FMCG or another manufacturing environment is a plus
- Fluent English; Dutch, French or German is an advantage

Engagement details
- Start: 2 November 2026
- Duration: 9 months, 4 days per week, with an option to extend
- Location: fully remote from Belgium, the Netherlands or Germany; on site in Antwerp or at one of our plants once or twice a month (travel costs reimbursed)
- Day rate: EUR 850 to 950, depending on experience
- Contract directly with Scheldewerf Foods NV as an independent contractor

Scheldewerf Foods is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual orientation.
